function: Predicts next LOS angle of arrival as a PMF from received samples, without CSI or pilots, to track and adapt beams of a UAV air-to-ground link (p. 2-4).
system: Air-to-ground link, ground BS 64-element ULA and UAV 16-element ULA, half-duplex, 30 GHz carrier, Rician LOS plus NLOS channel with Doppler and jitter; no RIS (p. 2, 4).
method: ResNet-18 CNN, supervised classification of next LOS angle over Q=256 bins with cross-entropy; its PMF feeds two rule-based adaptations, PBA-WS (weighted sum) and PBA-RS (top-2 choice) (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Self-simulated Rician geometric channel (LOS plus NLOS paths, Doppler, jittered angles) with smooth-turn UAV trajectories; no 3GPP channel, dataset, or measurement; training-set size not stated (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Training conditions not described; testing sweeps jitter standard deviation from 0.5 to 3.0 on 20 trajectories of 968 samples, W=16 (W=32 in Table I) (p. 4-5).
baselines: Classical: pilot-based tracking [8], adaptive beamwidth [13] fed by the CNN PMF; learned: own CNN without adaptation; plus true-angle bound (p. 5, Fig. 6).
metrics: Primary-peak accuracy (Table I), CDF of normalized beamforming gain (Fig. 5), average data rate and beam failure rate (gain below 0.5) versus jitter (Fig. 6) (p. 4-5).
q1_support: p. 2: "K is the Rician factor and N denotes the total number of non-line-of-sight (NLOS) paths" (own geometric model, Eq. 4); p. 4: 3GPP TR 38.901 [16] is cited only for "elements with directional gains [16]", not for the channel.
q2_support: p. 5: "performance is evaluated in 20 different trajectories for 968 samples"; p. 4: sigma_theta "swept from 0.5 to 3.0". Training conditions are never described, so no test on conditions unseen in training is stated; a jitter sweep alone does not count.
q3_support: p. 5: "we used the beamwidth adaptation scheme proposed in [13]" and "the pilot-based beam tracking scheme [8]" are non-learned; the only learned comparison is "CNN-based beam tracking without adaptation" (p. 4), the paper's own first stage, an ablation.
q4_support: p. 4: "The detailed model description is given in TABLE II", which lists only the ResNet-18 layer configuration; no parameter count, operations, or runtime is reported anywhere.
q5_support: p. 4: "smooth-turn (ST) mobility model [14] is adopted for UAV mobility model" shows self-generated data; no code or data link, public dataset, or measurement is given.
notes: Area 6 (beam control of an aerial link, UAV tied to NTNs on p. 1) wins over area 3 by the order of specificity. The CNN predicts the LOS angle, but its PMF drives the beamformer (Eqs. 12-13) and results are beamforming gain, rate, and beam failure, so it is not angle estimation alone; reviewer may confirm. q3 is 0 because the only learned comparison is the paper's own CNN without adaptation. Tables I-II and Figs. 5-6 were read from page images.
